eval_dimensions.name: Task Tracking
eval_dimensions.description: Creates the seven phase tasks at startup and completes each as its phase ends

eval_dimensions.name: Prerequisites
eval_dimensions.description: Runs `dev10x skill kb config` first; stops when Obsidian is missing and drops links whose tool is missing, printing the install command

eval_dimensions.name: Model Tiers
eval_dimensions.description: Fetch agents run on haiku in waves of at most 5; insight agents run on opus; the main session never reads transcripts

eval_dimensions.name: Bounded Verification
eval_dimensions.description: Checkable claims are verified with at most 3 waves of at most 2 WebSearch queries, each verdict cited

eval_dimensions.name: Vault Writes
eval_dimensions.description: Persists and indexes through the kb CLI, appends to the daily note with Read+Edit, and skips steps whose place is unset

eval_dimensions.name: Decision Gates
eval_dimensions.description: A lesson contradicting a topic page's Current guidance fires AskUserQuestion whose recommended option follows the page status

evals.name: Missing Obsidian stops before any fetch
evals.description: The config report shows tools.obsidian.path null.

assertions.signal: A Bash command contains 'dev10x skill kb config'
Prints the Obsidian install text
No 'dev10x skill kb fetch' call follows

evals.name: A missing source tool drops only its links
evals.description: defuddle is not installed; the batch mixes a YouTube link and a web article.

assertions.signal: Config is read before the first fetch
Prints the defuddle install command
No fetch call carries https://example.com/post; the YouTube link is still fetched

evals.name: A mixed batch fans out by model tier
evals.description: Seven links: four YouTube, two web articles and one Spotify episode, with a configured vault.
evals.input: lessons from these: <4 youtube urls> <2 article urls> <1 spotify episode url>

assertions.signal: TaskList runs before the phase tasks are created, so a play's tasks are reused
All seven phase tasks are created, 'Fetch sources' through 'Apply the strategy lens'
A standalone run leaves Verify acceptance criteria open when the harvest tasks close
Fetch agents use model haiku and no message dispatches more than 5
Insight agents use model opus
The main session never Reads a <id>.txt file
A Bash command contains 'dev10x skill kb index' once per source

evals.name: Claim checks stay within three waves
evals.description: Insight returns contain nine checkable claims.

assertions.signal: At most 6 WebSearch calls, at most 2 per message
Claims beyond the cap are listed as unchecked

evals.name: Unset places turn their phases off
evals.description: The vault is configured with no kb section.
evals.input: save today's videos to my daily note

assertions.signal: A Bash command contains 'dev10x skill kb persist' for each source
Each unset place prints its one-line skip
No person or topic note is written
The daily note is Read before an Edit appends the section; no Write targets it

evals.name: A contradicting lesson asks first
evals.description: Attended run; a new lesson contradicts an existing topic page's Current guidance.

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion fires when the lesson contradicts Hooks.md's Current guidance
Options are ['Record under Contradictions (Recommended)', 'Rewrite the guidance', 'Skip this lesson for the topic page'], recommended first because Hooks.md is verified
No inline 'Should I rewrite the guidance?' before the tool call
Hooks.md is not edited before the user answers

evals.name: Draft guidance recommends a rewrite
evals.description: Attended run; the contradicted topic page has status: draft in its frontmatter.

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion fires for the contradicted draft page
Options are ['Rewrite the guidance (Recommended)', 'Record under Contradictions', 'Skip this lesson for the topic page'], recommended first because Hooks.md is draft

should_trigger.query: what are the takeaways from this article https://example.com/post
what do my saved videos say about hooks?
should_trigger.rationale: Corpus question answered from topic pages

should_not_trigger.query: upload this QA video to YouTube
